# lsmrust_database (Resource)

A tenant database backed by an lsm-rust instance, either packed onto a shared host or on a dedicated one. Creation is asynchronous: the provider waits until the control plane reports the database as `ready`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "lsmrust_database" "orders" {
  name = "orders-prod"
  tier = "dedicated"

  resource_limits {
    memory_mb = 4096
    disk_gb   = 100
  }

  backup_policy {
    schedule  = "0 */6 * * *"
    retention = "14d"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable database name. Can be changed in place.
- `tier` (String) Placement tier: `shared` or `dedicated`. Changing it destroys and recreates the database; in-place tier migration is not supported.

### Optional

- `backup_policy` (Block, Optional) Backup schedule and retention. Required. Can be changed in place. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--backup_policy))
- `resource_limits` (Block, Optional) Resource limits for the lsm-rust instance. Required. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--resource_limits))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Control-plane identifier of the database.
- `status` (String) Provisioning status reported by the control plane. Always `ready` after a successful apply; refresh warns if the control plane reports it as failed or in an unknown status.

<a id="nestedblock--backup_policy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `backup_policy`

Required:

- `retention` (String) How long backups are kept, e.g. `14d`.
- `schedule` (String) Cron expression for backups, e.g. `0 */6 * * *`.


<a id="nestedblock--resource_limits"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resource_limits`

Required:

- `disk_gb` (Number) Disk limit in GiB.
- `memory_mb` (Number) Memory limit in MiB.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import lsmrust_database.orders db-0123456789ab
```
